findings.message: flutter_flavorizr says staging is com.drift.staging on Android, but Gradle builds com.drift.stagng.
findings.fix: Run flutter_flavorizr again, or make flavorizr.yaml and Gradle agree.

findings.message: ios/Runner/Info.plist says 2.0.0+9 but the pubspec says 2.0.0+10.
findings.fix: Set the plist to the pubspec version, or bump both together.

findings.message: Gradle has several flavor dimensions (region, tier); XPath reads flavors one dimension deep.
findings.fix: Edit the flavors of the profile by hand.

findings.message: The Debug, Profile and Release configurations of staging have different bundle ids.
findings.fix: Give the three configurations of staging the same PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER.

findings.message: Flavor staging is com.drift.stagng on Android and com.drift.staging on iOS, which looks like a typo.
findings.fix: If the two should match, fix the one that is misspelled; otherwise ignore this.

findings.message: The bundle id of prod is $(APP_BUNDLE_ID), a build variable.
findings.fix: Set PRODUCT_BUNDLE_IDENTIFIER to a literal in the target, or edit the bundle id in the profile.

findings.message: Flavor prod builds without a DEVELOPMENT_TEAM.
findings.fix: Select the team in Xcode, or keep one in the flavor's XPath credentials.

findings.message: Flavor prod has no lib/main_prod.dart, so it would build lib/main.dart.
findings.fix: Add lib/main_prod.dart, or set the entrypoint in the profile.

findings.message: The Info.plist of prod, ios/Runner/Info-Prod.plist, does not exist.
findings.fix: Create it or point INFOPLIST_FILE at the right file.

findings.message: shorebird.yaml has an app_id but no flavors, while the app has flavors: every flavor would share one Shorebird app.
findings.fix: Add a flavors: map to shorebird.yaml with one app id per flavor.

findings.message: ios/Runner/Info.plist hard-codes its version, so flutter build --build-name and --build-number do not reach iOS.
findings.fix: Use $(FLUTTER_BUILD_NAME) and $(FLUTTER_BUILD_NUMBER) in the plist, or let XPath write the version into it: the plist is listed in the version files of its flavors.

findings.message: .fvmrc pins "stable", which is not an exact Flutter version, so builds change when the channel moves.
findings.fix: Pin an exact version such as 3.47.4.

findings.message: Needs a Mac for iOS: Linux runners cannot build it because the app has the flavors staging, prod, which Linux iOS builds do not support yet (omarchy-apple-dev: flavors).
findings.fix: Nothing to do to build on a Mac. To build on Linux (ADR 0014), lift each reason; until then its iOS jobs wait for a Mac (ios-sign).

findings.message: The Gradle scripts do not read a key.properties file, so release builds are not signed with a release keystore from there.
findings.fix: Ignore this if signing is configured another way; otherwise add a release signingConfig that reads key.properties.
